summary: Reproduced the Facultad revision-9 PROJECT_FRONTIER_THIN defect exactly and repaired the smallest allocator rule. Revision 9 contained three grounded residual jobs, all intentionally capability-bound. classifyProjectGuideFrontier classified all three as capability_requirement, but compileRoleFrontier used effective_count=executable+active, yielding localReady=0 and gap=2 despite a full target frontier. The repair adds planner_count=executable+active+capability_requirement for planner scarcity only, while preserving effective_count for generic-worker executability and preserving specialized refs/capability metadata. PR #30 merged as 19fd36aca7f30739a1f1796eee390126ef41f8bc; descendant Efficiency Ratchet run 35343953849 passed all static non-regression checks including fast allocator capability fit.
